distilled_strategy: When the goal is directly adjacent with no holes in between, move straight toward it.

When the goal is in the same row or column but out of reach due to holes, first move to the adjacent row or column to a clear space. Then, maneuver vertically or horizontally to reach the goal, always staying on frozen tiles.

When the goal is aligned and not immediately blocked by holes, move forward or sideways on frozen tiles while avoiding holes. Adjust your path if necessary to break any blocks and clear any hidden obstacles before approaching the goal.
When the goal is on the same row or column as the player, and there are no holes in between, move diagonally to the goal.

When you are facing holes on your direct path to the goal, move to the right to establish an alternative path protected by a frozen block. Continue moving right until you encounter a hole or blocks your way.
When a hole is adjacent to your current position, move horizontally or vertically onto a frozen tile to avoid it, then continue moving to reach the goal in the direction you can see.
When the goal is blocked directly and a hole blocks proceed to the left, then move to the right if there's a hole there or go straight if there's ice.
When multiple frozen tiles lead to the goal and avoiding holes is the goal, move diagonally to explore directions that may give you the shortest path to the goal while navigating around holes.

When there's a hole in the way to the goal, move in a direction that will make your future path less obstructed from the cycle of holes. If you have a clear path in front, continue moving along the frozen tiles heading towards the goal.
When faced with blockade to the goal, make an L-shaped detour first. Ensure only frozen tiles and no holes are involved.

When there is only one hole between the starting point and the goal, move directly toward the goal. If there is more than one hole, count the number of holes. If there are 1 or 2 holes, choose a path that avoids a hole if possible; otherwise, move to the closest hole and then toward the goal.

When the goal is not directly reachable due to holes and there are no frozen tiles directly adjacent to it, identify the row or column with holes. Move the character sideways to the row or column without holes, then move the character diagonally diagonally to align the direction towards the goal.
